'''Dressel''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellians]] and primary [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Dressel system/Legends|Dressel system]].

==Geography==
[[File:DresselianNEGAS.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]]]]
By [[Human/Legends|Human]] standards, it was a pleasant world with a mixture of climates, including plains, hills, and [[Forest/Legends|forests]]. The Dressellians first evolved on the sub-equatorial grasslands of the main continent, [[Breehara]].

==History==
Discovered by [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] scouts of the [[Clan Askar]] around [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]], it was largely left alone by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], although visited by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] scouts. The Askars recognized the Dressellians and left them alone, settling in the [[Dressellian Asteroid Belt]] instead. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] occupied the planet around [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]]. The occupation was fiercely resisted by the Dressellians, who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and were early members of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

The planet had [[Senator/Legends|senatorial]] representation in both the New Republic and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. However, its representatives seldom attended congressional sessions unless encouraged to do so by their Bothan peers. However, following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], as Dressellian society continued to advance, many sociologists predicted the planet become an increasingly valuable and important member of the Alliance.

The [[Yuuzhan Vong]] seized control of Dressel during their invasion of the galaxy.<ref name="TEA" />
